height.$description: Standard heights of interactive controls that align in a form row: buttons, inputs, pickers. Pick by density and prominence, not by content.

compact.$description: Dense contexts: toolbars, inline filters, secondary actions where vertical space is scarce.

default.$description: The standard control height, matching the platform's comfortable touch row. Use unless density or prominence demands otherwise.

large.$description: Prominent controls: primary call to action, hero forms. The tallest step; if it feels insufficient, redesign the layout instead of scaling up.

icon.$description: Optical steps for icon dimensions. Pick by the size of the surrounding context; the first three steps pair with the control heights.

extraLarge.$description: Prominent standalone icons: feature highlights, decorative accents. The largest UI-icon step.

large.$description: In a large control, navigation bars, or as a standalone interactive icon.

medium.$description: In a default-height control or beside body-scale text.

small.$description: In a compact control or beside caption-scale text.
